question: Is gene-level LOSO 0.90/0.97 overfit?

verdict.de_ranking_essential: NO — fixed phenotype module genes as individuals already reach 4class 0.92 / reox 0.97
verdict.main_driver: Within-subject multi-baseline features (especially delta-from-hypoxia) + treating genes as separate features instead of module means
verdict.optimism_in_loso: YES mild — fixed held-out drops 4class to 0.67–0.83; reox stays 0.83–1.00 on n=6
verdict.random_gene_floor: High — random 30 genes: 4class mean 0.81, reox mean 0.85. DE ranking adds ~0.09 / ~0.12 over random
verdict.dimensionality_risk: Present for reox (~90 features / ~28 train samples). Prefer top_n<=10 or fixed phenotype genes.
verdict.gene_stability: Moderate — 6 genes in all 15 folds; 11 in >=12 folds; 75 unique genes ever selected at top_n=20

recommendations: Report fixed held-out or external metrics as primary, not only fold-wise LOSO
Prefer individual phenotype-module genes or a frozen stable gene set for deployment
Do not claim recovery-DE ranking alone produced the 0.97 reox accuracy
External GSE117192 module-mean 0.81 remains the cleanest independent check

honest_headline_numbers.best_supported_4class: 0.83 fixed-heldout; LOSO 0.90 has mild selection optimism
honest_headline_numbers.best_supported_reox: 0.83 fixed-heldout; LOSO ~0.97 but random genes already ~0.85
